title: A coNP inclusion from randomized SAT
statement: If the complement of the language of satisfiable 3-CNF formulas belongs to BPNP, then every language in coNP has polynomial-size, fan-in-two circuit certificates; that is, coNP is contained in the class of languages recognized by such circuits with polynomially many existential Boolean inputs.
hypotheses_covered: The complement of SAT3 belongs to BPNP
